note: Generated by tools/gen-voice.js with Gemini text-to-speech. Played when the live AI voice is not available.

greet.text: Hi! I'm your travel buddy. Look at me any time if you need help.

hello.text: Hello! How are you feeling today?

calm.text: Let's take one slow breath together. In... and out. You're doing well. Ready to go on?

praise:direction.text: Great choice! That's the right way.

praise:arrived.text: You did it! You arrived at 28 May. Well done!

err:insufficient_balance.text: That's okay. The card does not have enough money yet. Let's top it up at the machine on the left.

err:card_not_read.text: That happens sometimes. Hold the card still on the reader, and try again.

err:wrong_direction.text: That's okay. Read the station names on the signs, and find 28 May.

err:exit_too_early.text: Not yet. Listen to the announcements. We get off at 28 May.

err:missed_stop.text: We passed our stop. That's okay, it happens to everyone. Let's get off here and take the train back.

ride:get_ready.text: The next station is 28 May. Get ready to get off.

ride:return.text: Now we take the train back to 28 May. Well done for staying calm.

fault:delay.text: The train is a little late. That's okay. We can wait here together. Let's take one slow breath.

fault:crowd.text: It's busy and noisy here. Let's breathe together. In for four... and out for four. You're doing well.

hint:topup:1.text: First we put money on the card. The top-up machine is on your left.

hint:topup:2.text: Look for the glowing machine on your left.

hint:topup:3.text: Turn left. Look at the glowing machine and hold your look for a moment.

hint:gate:1.text: Now we go through the turnstile. Touch the card to the green reader.

hint:gate:2.text: Look for the glowing turnstile in front of you.

hint:gate:3.text: Look straight ahead at the glowing reader and hold your look for a moment.

hint:platform:1.text: Read the station names on each sign. Which sign shows 28 May?

hint:platform:2.text: 28 May is on the sign towards Icherisheher.

hint:platform:3.text: Look at the glowing sign towards Icherisheher.

hint:ride:1.text: This is 28 May. This is our station!

hint:ride:2.text: Look at the glowing doors to get off.

hint:ride:3.text: The doors are open. Look at the doors and hold your look for a moment to get off here.
